summary: Iteration 2 validation of Digital Chai & Coffee Lounge (Named Rooms, Typing Dots, Lofi Radio). Backend: extended pytest suite to 14 tests (11 original + 3 new: room isolation, same-room cross-talk, typing broadcast excludes sender + active:false forwarded). All 14 passed. Frontend Playwright: single-session demo verified HUD 'Public Lounge' label, invite-btn copies URL adding ?room=lounge, lofi-toggle-btn toggles play/pause with no console errors, lofi-volume slider adjusts volume, chat send + typing dots bubble render on canvas. Two-session same-private-room ('test-abc123') verified: room prefilled from ?room= URL for guest, guest count shows '2 guests' in both sessions, chat 'hi from A' and 'hi from B' cross-sync bidirectionally, private room name displayed in HUD. Zero JS/console errors across all flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py broadcast/typing correctly excludes sender via exclude=client_id; rooms cleaned up when empty - good.
useLounge.js: WS reconnect timer (1.5s) fine; still uses string replace for ws scheme (previously flagged, minor).
AvatarSetup treats room 'lounge' as public (line 51) — consistent with backend default. No issue.
Lofi/audio autoplay may be blocked in some browsers; UI handles gracefully (no crashes observed).
test_credentials: None (no auth). ?demo=1 auto-joins as 'Bo' in public 'lounge'. ?room=CODE prefills room field.
